column1: At Daimler Truck Innovation Center India (DTICI) in Bengaluru, I scaled fleet Spark ETL scripts originally written for 50 vehicles to 175k+ capacity (~70,000 live trucks) and replaced dedicated Power BI servers with a FastAPI + React Databricks app that loads ~3x faster at less than half the compute spend.

Outside work, I solo-built the bilingual FiT-UC Flutter app on Google Play for Udayan Care NGO—saving ₹1,00,000+ in build quotes and ~30% field Excel time—hosted on a consolidated Proxmox VE 8 Linux server that also runs a 6-node K3s lab.
